Whether you're a seasoned collector or simply looking for a unique piece to add to your home, this antique shop is a must-visit. It's a place where you can discover the beauty and charm of the past.

featured_reviews.name: Graceson Paul
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely unprofessional and disrespectful behaviour from the store owner.

I was in the process of purchasing an expensive guitar and amplifier (approximately ₹1.30 lakh) for my student. The owner was eager to close the deal and insisted that I come on Sunday to collect the instruments. I clearly informed him that I would reach by 4:45 pm and make a quick purchase.

However, since Malad is not my usual route, I got badly stuck in traffic and kept him informed. Despite this, I eventually reached at 5:30 pm, while the store’s closing time was 5:00 pm.

While I understand and accept that reaching after closing time was my mistake, the way the situation was handled was completely unacceptable. Instead of politely informing me that the store was closed and asking me to come another day, the owner shouted at me over the phone and lectured me about “time values,” using a rude and condescending tone.

This is not how a customer—especially one making a high-value purchase—should be spoken to. Delays can happen, and when a customer communicates honestly and makes the effort to travel a long distance, basic courtesy and professionalism are expected.

The owner seriously needs to control his anger. Such behaviour is not good and definitely not good for business. Unfortunately, this experience showed a clear lack of professionalism and respect. I would advise potential customers to be cautious.
